cases.description: A callback-style package copies bounded byte chunks with partial-write retry, fsync and descriptor closure before the application publishes the result.
A scoped ESM package uses callback readdir and stat imports to inventory real files, then the application checks sorted metadata and publishes JSON.
A callback-style package promisifies raw descriptor vector I/O without losing byte counts, plural/singular result fields or the original arrays.
A build package awaits Promise-valued callback-copy filters, prunes a private directory and publishes selected assets only after rename and access complete.
A package closes its descriptor before a later read and must report EBADF with zero progress and original buffer, never successful partial publication.
